description: This Java class implements a custom handler for successful user authentication events in a Spring Security context. It updates the user's login timestamps and redirects to the admin home page upon successful login.

classes.name: UserAuthenticationSuccessHandler
classes.description: A handler that manages post-authentication logic such as updating login timestamps and redirecting.

methods.name: onAuthenticationSuccess
methods.description: Overrides the default method to update the user's last access and login time, then redirects to the admin home page.
